provenance.notes: Upstream aggregates the Ultimate-Edition card pool; per-card expansion attribution is not encoded there and the official sources we have do not list card-by-card set membership. Official count note: the 2012 rulebook scenario book refers to the base Advanced Action deck by number ranges (16 used in the first scenario, 12 more removed), and the UE walkthrough states 'There are 28 Advanced Action cards' (base game). Upstream ships 44 -> likely base 28 + Lost Legion 16, UNVERIFIED per card.
